content.title: Where to watch Braves vs. Royals MLB game tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: TV & StreamingUpdated: Mar. 28, 2026, 3:45 p.m.Published: Mar. 28, 2026, 3:43 p.m.FILE - Atlanta Braves' Ronald Acuña Jr. reacts while standing on third base in the fourth inning of a baseball game against the New York Yankees, Friday, July 18, 2025, in Atlanta. (AP Photo/Colin Hubbard, File)APBy Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Atlanta Braves are out to clinch their opening series of the 2026 season with Game 2 against the Kansas City Royals set for Saturday night at Truist Park. The game is scheduled to start at 7:15 p.m. ET with TV coverage on FOX and streaming on-demand.How to watch Braves vs. Royals on TV and stream without cable:When: Saturday, March 28 at 7:15 p.m. ETWhere: Truist Park, Atlanta, Ga.TV channel: FOXStreaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate)Braves vs. Royals: The matchupThe Braves got off to a hot start with a 6-0 shutout win over a Royals team that went 82-80 a year ago. Atlanta ace Chris Sale anchored a shutout effort, allowing three hits with three walks and eight strikeouts, while relievers Dylan Lee, Robert Suarez and Tyler Kinley finished off the victory with a scoreless frame apiece. Home runs by Ozzie Albies, Drake Baldwin and Michael Harris II sparked a Braves offense that finished with 11 hits.The Braves will start right-hander Reynaldo Lopez, who was limited to just one start in 2025 after posting a 1.99 ERA in ‘24, in Saturday’s Game 2. The Royals will counter with righty Michael Wacha, who comes off a 10-13 season with a 3.86 ERA.
